NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_20_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:queennanny}{EXCITED:queennanny}Everyone dreams of a blissful life!
{SAY:winnie}We have to return to reality!
{EXCITED:queennanny}Living in a happy fairytale will absolve you from your misery!
{SAY:queennanny}We don't need reality anymore! Better have it be swallowed by dreams of fairytales...
{EXCITED:queennanny}Join me and let this dream expand! Absolve many others from suffering!
{EXCITED:queennanny}The choice of everyone's happiness is in your hand!
{SAY:winnie}Nobody should have authority over other's happiness-
{SPECIAL1:queennanny}Shut up, SHUT THE @#$% UP, YOU INCESSANT MACHINE!
{SHOUT:queennanny}You have no say in this matter!
{EXCITED:crazydave}Don't talk to her like that!
{SAY:queennanny}"Her?" I already told you! This machine...
{SAY:queennanny}If you join me, I can make any of your dreams come true!
{TIRED:crazydave}...is right. Is it really happiness if it's just an illusion and lies?
{SAY:queennanny}Why must you care for the frivolous details!?
{SAY:queennanny}Don't you want to be happy?
{SAY:crazydave}...
{TIRED:crazydave}I might've been happier in the past, but...
{TIRED:crazydave}Fighting zombies... with my plants, with my neighbor...
{TIRED:crazydave}...with Penny.
{SAY:crazydave}That is how I choose to be happy now. And that choice...
{TIRED:crazydave}...it's what I'm taking away from everyone if I let this dream continue!
{EXCITED:crazydave}I'm not joining you! ALL of us will escape this dream!
{TIRED:crazydave}Any dream?
{SPECIAL2:queennanny}You... you moronic baboon! You @#$%^!, !@#$%^!
{SHOUT:queennanny}Why can't you understand!? It's a hard knock life out there!
{EXCITED:queennanny}There is no happiness waiting for you in reality!
{SAY:queennanny}So be it! If you won't be lulled to the embrace of a pleasant dream...
{SHOUT:queennanny}...then you shall cower beneath an UNRELENTING NIGHTMARE!
{SHOUT:queennanny}OFF WITH YOUR HEADS!
{SAY:queennanny}Stop resisting. Be a kid again! As long as you steer off the cliff-
{SAY:queennanny}-you can spend the rest of your days blissfully running along the field of rye.
{TIRED:crazydave}I...
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}...what is going on?
{EXCITED:queennanny}Pay this machine no attention! Embrace your desire and join me!
{EXCITED:winnie}What!? User Dave, you can't seriously be considering this!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_21_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:queennanny}{SHOUT:queennanny}Why, why, WHY!?
{TIRED:queennanny}That's all he... that's all the world ever does. It takes, and it takes, and it takes-
{SHOUT:queennanny}Curse him! Curse his deplorable imps, endlessly tormenting me...
{SHOUT:queennanny}Curse you! Curse your camping van! Curse your complicit neighbor!
{SAY:queennanny}Curse these disgusting plants! And... and...
{TIRED:queennanny}Curse her, that wicked witch! She left me behind! She...
{TIRED:crazydave}Nanny...
{SAY:queennanny}Look into the future... hah. Haha. HA-HA-HA-HA!
{EXCITED:queennanny}So be it. This dream shall be THE FUTURE!
{EXCITED:queennanny}I will override our rotten world, our painful reality, with these fairytales...
{EXCITED:queennanny}...and I will eliminate everyone who has ever wronged me! Starting with you!
{SHOUT:queennanny}Everyone else gets to live their happily ever after! So WHY?
{SAY:queennanny}Yes... this is how things should be.
{TIRED:crazydave}Please don't do this...
{SHOUT:queennanny}The world is about to change! Your existence... WON'T BELONG THERE!
{SAY:queennanny}I thought I could just leave you be... but you're like a plague.
{SHOUT:queennanny}I'll have to get rid of ALL OF YOU!
{SHOUT:queennanny}Why can't you... why won't you just let me be happy?
{SAY:crazydave}We never said we want you to be unhappy!
{TIRED:crazydave}But we just can't be a kid reading fairytales forever.
{TIRED:crazydave}We have to grow up eventually.
{SAY:winnie}You have to look into the now, and the future.
{TIRED:queennanny}...look into the future...?
{SHOUT:queennanny}...I HAVE NO FUTURE! ZOMBOSS TOOK IT AWAY FROM ME!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_22_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I must warn you both. This dream is growing more unstable by the day.
{SAY:crazydave}...
{TIRED:crazydave}...look, Penny. I know she's the enemy...
{TIRED:crazydave}But I just can't help feeling bad for her.
{TIRED:winnie}...
{TIRED:winnie}The Nanny... she's right. I am a machine. Only ever programmed to terminate zombies.
{TIRED:winnie}I do not know what it is to dream, or hope.
{SAY:crazydave}What? Penny, what are you talking about?
{TIRED:winnie}I never got anyone's fascination with this realm. I only ever see it as a cage.
{PLAYFUL:winnie}But... I think I'd like to. I want to know how it "feels" to be happy. To make you happy.
{SAY:winnie}So that you never end up like her.
{SAY:winnie}No doubt due to The Nanny's deteriorating mental state.
{SAY:crazydave}Penny...
{PLAYFUL:winnie}But that's what I'm getting at. If a machine like me can have her "heart" changed...
{PLAYFUL:winnie}...who's to say we can't change The Nanny's too?
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Penny... you were always more than a machine to me! You're my companion!
{EXCITED:crazydave}And you too, neighbor, and all our plants. We're a team!
{EXCITED:crazydave}We can do it! We can save the world!
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}...and let's hope that we can change her heart too.
{SAY:winnie}Soon this dream will leak into reality.
{SAY:winnie}Once that happens, I don't know if it will be reversible.
{SAY:crazydave}Did you not find any exits yesterday? Are we just stuck here?
{SAY:winnie}Not necessarily. I believe there's still one way for us to leave this place.
{SAY:winnie}Remember, anything that The Nanny wants to happen in this place, happens.
{SAY:winnie}So, the only way for this dream to end, is for The Nanny herself to wish for it.
{TIRED:crazydave}But how? You saw her the other day! She was...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_22_OUTRO_: {SAY:queennannyboss}I have arranged for you to be able to see it personally.
{PLAYFUL:queennannyboss}I even have a surprise lined up for you.
{PLAYFUL:queennannyboss}Will it be good? Oh, don't worry sir.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_23_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Is this real...? Or is it just a figment of an ailing old mind?
{SAY:zombossicon}No, I've been looking for more of them. The L.O.A.M parts!
{SAY:zombossicon}When I retrieved those books, I sensed that they contained magical power!
{SAY:zombossicon}But they weren't L.O.A.M parts. I've no use for it. That's why I discarded them.
{SAY:zombossicon}To think it was still capable of such a magnificent feat!
{SAY:zombossicon}Perhaps I shouldn't judge a book by its cover...
{SAY:zombossicon}Anyway, enough pleasantries! The Nanny still has something she wanted to show me...
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{TIRED:crazydave}Why would The Nanny bring him here!? Unless...
{NPC_ENTER:queennanny}{EXCITED:queennanny}When I said I'm going to eliminate those who've wronged me... I meant it!
{SAY:winnie}You mean to exterminate him by bringing him here?
{EXCITED:queennanny}That idiot is way too prideful and ignorant to ever consider I would betray him!
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Boss Man...!? How are YOU here?
{SAY:queennanny}I only needed to lure him under lies and empty promises...
{EXCITED:queennanny}Just like he did to me once before!
{TIRED:crazydave}What are you planning with him?
{PLAYFUL:queennanny}Oh, do not worry. You three got front row seats for that.
{EXCITED:queennanny}HA-HA-HA-HA-HA!
{SAY:zombossicon}Ah, you two are here as well, so she was right.
{SAY:winnie}Did The Nanny bring you in here?
{SAY:zombossicon}She did. She told me she had something she wanted to show me.
{SAY:zombossicon}I thought it was just gonna be another one of her mundane drivels...
{SAY:zombossicon}But she told me she created a realm, using those books I gave her, too!
{TIRED:crazydave}How did you get your hands on those books?
{SAY:zombossicon}You think I've just been twiddling my thumbs when I'm not fighting you?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_23_OUTRO_: {SAY:zombossicon}I shall take this beast for a test ride!
{SAY:zombossicon}My judgement never failed. I knew I saw who you truly are the day I hired you.
{SAY:queennannyboss}Yes sir, I can create anything I want here.
{SAY:zombossicon}For what purpose did you do this?
{SAY:queennannyboss}You've given me so much, I thought I'd repay you.
{SAY:zombossicon}Heh. I suppose that's true. Without me, you would've been nothing, wouldn't you?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_24_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}Penny, I think this world is finally getting to me!
{SAY:winnie}...shaped based on your selfish views of what the world should look like.
{SHOUT:queennannyboss}Shut up, SHUT UP!
{SHOUT:queennannyboss}Zomboss robbed me of my future, with his false charms and promises!
{EXCITED:queennannyboss}He's the evil wizard that needs to be usurped at this tale's end!
{SAY:queennannyboss}Ha... HA-HA-HA!
{SHOUT:queennannyboss}That's why... I shall rob him of his LIFE!
{TIRED:crazydave}Penny's right. This isn't even about creating a perfect world anymore, is it?
{SAY:queennannyboss}Pawns do not get to speak to the Queen.
{SAY:queennannyboss}This is a matter between The Wizard... and I.
{EXCITED:queennannyboss}Play your part, and KILL each other. Pave the way for me to Easy Street!
{TIRED:crazydave}I just saw something huge flying over us...
{SAY:queennannyboss}This is how it should be, yes. I can feel it in my grasp.
{SAY:queennannyboss}My new world... It will be...
{PLAYFUL:queennannyboss}Heaven...
{NPC_EXIT:queennannyboss}{SAY:winnie}I'm sensing tonight will be a relentless assault of the likes we've never seen.
{EXCITED:crazydave}We'll win this, Penny! We have to!
{PLAYFUL:winnie}Thank you, User Dave. Still...
{EXCITED:winnie}The Nanny is pulling out all the stops. So let's not hold back either.
{SHOUT:crazydave}...and it had THREE HEADS!?
{SAY:winnie}That must be the bait The Nanny used to lure Zomboss in here.
{NPC_ENTER:queennannyboss}{PLAYFUL:queennannyboss}Oh... him and his stupid little imps are so easy!
{PLAYFUL:queennannyboss}Jingle some keys... give them a new toy, and they'll do anything you want!
{SAY:winnie}There's still time to stop your plans. I don't think you understand the ramifications.
{EXCITED:queennannyboss}Ramifications? I'm doing the world a favor, even when it never did me any!
{SAY:queennannyboss}I'm creating the perfect world. A fairytale without pain nor suffering.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_25_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Greetings, David, puny plants, and assorted allies.
{SAY:zombossicon}Its shield is extremely durable to attacks! And tonight, you shall taste its wrath!

{EXCITED:crazydave}We need to be tactical with our mirrors then!

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_25_OUTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}GAH! How could this be!? You told me this Zombot was indestructible!

{PLAYFUL:winnie}Well, that's one way to know we've escaped the dream, isn't it?
{SAY:winnie}Reality hardly ever has a simple, happily ever after, User Dave.

{NPC_ENTER:queennannyboss}{SPECIAL2:queennannyboss}NO! @#$%! @#$%! @$%%! WHY DIDN'T YOU KILL EACH OTHER!?
{TIRED:queennannyboss}My dream! M-My Heaven! My...

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_2_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SHOUT:crazydave}Nope! Nuh-uh! Big no on those cards being beneficial to us!
{EXCITED:crazydave}A magical shield! Right back at you, zombies!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_2_INTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Perhaps that isn't all there is to it, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_2_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:winnie}As you might have noticed, another magical object has appeared on the lawn today.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_2_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}They have little vines growing around them...

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_2_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}They contain magical energy that can reflect magic card projectiles.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_2_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}We can use this to our advantage to reflect card projectiles back at zombies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_3_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}I gotta say, even if this is supposed to be precarious, I'm having fun!
{SAY:crazydave}Hmmm... no. Not really. All I remember is that a zombie dropped it.
{SAY:crazydave}Bah! Let's just table this boring talk for later!
{EXCITED:crazydave}This little guy must be eager to throw its hat into the ring!
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}You can be a squire to the Great Knight! Let's march ahead!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_3_INTRO_2: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}This place reminds me so much of the story Mama Dave used to tell before bed!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_3_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}A knight on a quest in a magical forest, triumphing over the evil zombie army!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_3_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}It seems that this forest contains not only zombies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_3_INTRO_6: {EXCITED:winnie}It attacks zombies by launching its hat, which will then ricochet off to other obstacles.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_3_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}Where did he come from? Same way as us?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_3_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}That I can't be sure of. I'm still conducting scans on the nature of this "magic book."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_3_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Is there anything about it that you can recall?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_4_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}I'm forecasting a certain type of mist will be enshrouding this area in a moment.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Worry not, Penny! The Great Knight Dave is here to save the day!
{EXCITED:crazydave}When they appear, it'll be our time to heroically strike them down!
{TIRED:winnie}Let's avoid fights if we can help it. Our top priority is to escape.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Hey, come on! Indulge in a little fun, won't you, Penny?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_4_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}It seems to affect plants and zombies in different ways.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_4_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}When shrouded by fog, zombies will receive boosts.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_4_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Our plants, meanwhile, will be cast into a deep slumber.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_4_INTRO_6: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Hey, you can't sleep on the job! Mushrooms don't even do that anymore!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_4_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}I'm also sensing another additional presence amidst this mist.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_4_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}It seems to be a significantly powerful zombie.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_5_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}I'm seeing a new challenger on the horizon! The cavalry's here!
{TIRED:winnie}Could this cavalry have been sent by their leader as reinforcement?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_5_INTRO_2: {TIRED:winnie}Yes, an enemy knight... riding on a unicorn.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_5_INTRO_3: {TIRED:winnie}This is slowly becoming more and more ridiculous.

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_5_INTRO_5: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Just watch, that unicorn is gonna throw him off the first chance it gets!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_5_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Perhaps it is a good time to utilize our new ally.

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_5_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}These springs will then stay on the tile, knocking zombies back before expiring.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_5_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:crazydave}Another addition to the Great Knight's troupe!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I'm detecting a new set of cards bearing the diamond suit.
{SAY:winnie}I see you managed to make the connection eventually, User Dave.

{SPECIAL1:nanny}Of @#$%! course. Of course it's a MAGICAL book!

{TIRED:nanny}An imp must've stolen one of them from my study after Zomboss gave them to me.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_2: {TIRED:crazydave}That cavalry from last time had a diamond mark...

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Different cards have different effects as well.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}This also applies to their reflected effects. So keep all that in mind.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_7: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Sheesh, there's so much to keep track of! Cards, mirrors, fogs...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}Hmmm... I don't know why, but the fog here looks more like smoke!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_9: {TIRED:crazydave}That... and the mirrors... it's giving me a certain image...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_7_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}My sensors are picking up a faint trace of mischief in the air.
{SAY:nanny}Even in this here la-la-land... I can't get these brats under control!
{TIRED:nanny}I wish they would just listen to me for once!
{NPC_EXIT:nanny}{TIRED:winnie}So we are facing an imp that can appear and disappear at will...
{SAY:crazydave}Oh no! Will our plants be able to see it?
{EXCITED:winnie}Perhaps our new companion, Ent, can be of help.
{SAY:winnie}He's a wall that attacks zombies in a range in front of it.
{SAY:winnie}He will also heal himself periodically anytime he's not being attacked by zombies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_7_INTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:nanny}{SPECIAL1:nanny}Imps! @#$%^! Imps! That's what's causing this... hootenany!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_7_INTRO_4: {SAY:nanny}I was finally beginning to relax, imagining myself away from little runts...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_7_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:nanny}This... thing! It manifested! What is it? Is it a cat? An imp?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_7_INTRO_6: {SAY:nanny}When I tried to get a closer look, it vanished!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_7_INTRO_8: {EXCITED:nanny}Oh, it's still there alright, I can hear it cackling! It somehow turned invisible!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_7_INTRO_9: {SPECIAL1:nanny}Suddenly, the little @#$%^ reappeared and shoved my head into a tree!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_8_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:winnie}Try as hard as I may, I still haven't been able to crack this magic book.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Who knows? Maybe something good will happen!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_8_INTRO_2: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Maybe you should focus more on what's in front of you, Penny!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_8_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, deciphering this mystery is our key to return home-
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_8_INTRO_4: {TIRED:crazydave}No, I mean that literally! Look in front of you! What are those things?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_8_INTRO_6: {TIRED:winnie}Apologies. I was so fixated on the book that I hadn't noticed these...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_8_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}It looks like there's some type of potion in here!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_8_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:crazydave}Hey, neighbor! Why don't you try putting plant food in these potions?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_9_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}So, to recap, The Nanny had gotten her hands on a collection of magical books.
{PLAYFUL:nanny}Tell you what, this place does remind me of the bedtime stories ma used to tell me.
{SAY:nanny}Stupid little tales where everyone's happy all the time. Gross.
{PLAYFUL:nanny}As if life could ever be that simple.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}But wouldn't it be fun if life was always simple like this?
{PLAYFUL:nanny}Heh. I suppose for idiots like you, having fun is all there is to life, huh?
{TIRED:winnie}I still don't get it. What does this all mean?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_9_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}We've gotten our own hands on one of these books, courtesy of a slight-handed imp.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_9_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}After that, you opened the book, and we ended up here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_9_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Negative. Scans suggest that The Nanny arrived here before us.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_9_INTRO_6: {TIRED:crazydave}Wait, so she fell into the book first?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_9_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}Falling into a book... is that what happened?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_9_INTRO_8: {EXCITED:crazydave}Are we inside a magic book? Are we living a fairytale?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_9_INTRO_9: {TIRED:winnie}Somehow, I feel like there's more to it than that.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_01_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}Let me run a diagnosis on the damage from the crash landing.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_01_INTRO_13: {TIRED:winnie}User Dave, my time travelling systems are down.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_01_INTRO_14: {TIRED:winnie}We're going to be stuck here for the forseeable future.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_01_INTRO_16: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, we have arrived back to the ice age decades after our previous visit.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_01_INTRO_18: {SAY:winnie}Slider Tiles will change direction during the day as a result.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_01_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, what has happened during my blackout?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_01_INTRO_7: {EXCITED:crazydave}It all went nuts and we crashed here!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_01_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}Well, at least we got to our desired location.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_01_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}There is a plant here in dire need of rescuing.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_02_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I must inform you of new observations.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_02_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}They're immensely hungry, we must remain cautious.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_02_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Observation #1: It will take a while for my engines to repair themselves as some parts got frozen in ice.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_02_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Observation #2: The plant in need of rescue is near.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_02_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Observation #3: The zombies here are the descendants of the zombies left over from Zomboss's last visit.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_02_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Observation #4: These zombies have been abandoned by Zomboss and left to fend for themselves.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_02_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}It is quite impressive how much they've evolved to adapt to these harsher circumstances.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_02_INTRO_8: {TIRED:crazydave}I almost feel kinda sorry for them...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_02_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}They are still zombies at the end of the day, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_03_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I have finally located the plant in need of rescuing.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_03_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Flameweed rapidly torches zombies, including flying ones.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_03_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}His flaming hot body also provides adequate heat to nearby plants.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_03_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:crazydave}Finally! It's about time we got some help!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_03_INTRO_6: {EXCITED:crazydave}Once we rescue this plant, we'll be able to melt the ice in no time!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_05_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}My engines are being repaired at a steady rate, however, the motor repairs have just begun.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_05_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}We need to make sure they don't pierce our defenses with their arsenal of weapons.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_05_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Penny, I see something in the distance!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_05_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}Kinda hard to make out over all the snow!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_05_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}My sensors are picking it up too.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_05_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}Shellshock Hunters appear to be much more advanced compared to regular Hunter Zombies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_05_INTRO_9: {TIRED:crazydave}I've got a bad feeling about this. My seventh sense is kicking in.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_07_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}Furthermore, their skin is completely fire proof due to their burns.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_07_INTRO_11: {EXCITED:crazydave}Burning yourself makes you immune to fire AND ice!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_07_INTRO_13: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}What do they call it... alternative medicine?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_07_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Great, I can't wait to get out of here!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_07_INTRO_3: {TIRED:crazydave}Almost feels like I'm getting hallucinations at this point...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_07_INTRO_4: {TIRED:crazydave}All I see is snow and ice and snow and more ice...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_07_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:crazydave}I've even seen some zombies burned alive and survive!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_07_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Their body temperature is barely above zero, making them immune to chill.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}All tribes have their members: Leaders, chiefs...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}It seems we've already gained the attention of the chiefs.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}During this time period, chiefs were particularly deadly.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}Their mastery of cold breathing leads to entire lanes of frozen fighters.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}We must provide more heating than ever.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_15: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Hey, a little bit of stink breath's never killed anyone.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_16: {SAY:crazydave}Besides, I think it's kind of neat that these zombies have separated from Boss Man.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_17: {SAY:crazydave}Maybe a new leader for them really can work.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_18: {EXCITED:winnie}It's an interesting notion, and given the evidence, highly likely.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_19: {SAY:winnie}There's no existing data to match such a scenario.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}If Zomboss abandoned these zombies, they're all scattered and without purpose!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_20: {SAY:winnie}Perhaps we haven't crash landed to remain and observe these occurrences without reason.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Logic dictates that there had to have been a zombie powerful enough to become their leader.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}If we continue defending ourselves we will eventually catch their attention.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}My engines are 50% repaired, so there's a chance we will be able to flee from this place before then.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Speaking of, my scanners are detecting new incoming threats...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}These zombies might have evolved into a brand new hierarchy.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_12_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I'm noticing a lot more zombies on the horizon than usual.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_12_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}Just because they're not lead by Zomboss doesn't mean they're any less dangerous.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_12_INTRO_11: {TIRED:winnie}If anything, they're more unpredictable. I've documented all of Zomboss's patterns.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_12_INTRO_13: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}So it's leader a leader here, huh?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_12_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}We appear to have gotten on the leader's radar.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_12_INTRO_3: {TIRED:winnie}This is bad. My engines are nowhere near ready.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_12_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}A hero to his people, the acquirer of brains.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_12_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}An avalanche fighter and the king of the tribe.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_12_INTRO_9: {SAY:crazydave}This is the first time we're fighting off a zombie horde not lead by Boss Man, right?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, I've got lots of good news!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}They should have all retreated and left us alone.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_11: {SAY:crazydave}Do you think they're just that hungry?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}Even if they were, they'd still follow the orders of their leader.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}Stranger more... there's a brand new type of evolved zombie.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}The Weasel Queen will summon Permafrost Weasels who are even more durable.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_16: {SAY:winnie}Once her log is broken, she will yodel for even further weasel support.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_17: {EXCITED:crazydave}Now this just plainly doesn't make any sense!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_18: {EXCITED:crazydave}If I know zombies, which I do, they'd have stopped at this point!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_19: {SAY:crazydave}Maybe do a dance party too, but sending in new troops?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:winnie}First of all, my engines are 75% repaired!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_21: {SAY:winnie}Indeed. It defies all previously encountered patterns.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_22: {SAY:winnie}I'll run analysis, in the meantime, these zombies should be fended off.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_23: {EXCITED:crazydave}We should use Flameweed, he's got quite an itching for torching zombie weasels!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:winnie}Secondly, Elder Hailstorm and his cronies have retreated!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Status of Elder Hailstorm is still unknown.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}That's odd, I swear I've seen some zombies still approaching?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}You appear to be correct, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}This is most unusual. Their leader has been defeated.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, something quite unprecedented has happened!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}"Me respect you when find who you are."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}"Our old bad leader return. Divide happen."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}"Me stand by my people. We not allow big brain zombie to retake leader."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}"Cowards from tribe joined his side, rest of us hiding."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_17: {SAY:winnie}"Help the tribe Me ask. We not want serve bad leader again."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}We appear to have gotten a stone tablet letter from the zombie tribe.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_20: {EXCITED:winnie}This is unprecedented. We have been asked for aid by a zombie group.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_21: {SAY:crazydave}From the guys that Boss Man abandoned?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_24: {SAY:winnie}The zombies still attacking us are from the tribe, but they switched sides once Zomboss returned.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_25: {EXCITED:crazydave}This is too crazy even for me!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_26: {SAY:winnie}It seems Zomboss hasn't noticed we're here yet.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_27: {SAY:winnie}I'll calculate our next plan of action.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}Oh. Well, that's quite normal, we've gotten loads of those.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}It's written in a very poorly constructed primitive language, but I believe I can translate it.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}"Me Elder Hailstorm! I order writing and delivering of this letter!"
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}"The attack from yesterday not from us. Me find you not as prey anymore."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, my engines have fully repaired. We should go now.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}If you wish us to stay and help, we shall.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}Actually Penny, I think I wanna stay for a bit longer.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}What is your reasoning for this illogical action, User Dave?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:crazydave}You heard the Elder Guy, Penny! These zombies need our help!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:crazydave}Boss Man wants to be their leader again, but they already got a new leader!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_6: {EXCITED:crazydave}And that leader actually wants to be pals with us!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}I don't think that entirely reflects the situation.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}My sensors indicate a 66% chance of these zombies betraying us.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:crazydave}We gotta believe them Penny! Elder Guy even said he "respect us."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_10: {SAY:zombossicon}A busy evildoer such as myself has too much to worry about to remember small things like that.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}You have to admit Zomboss, you should've seen this coming.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_12: {SAY:zombossicon}Enough about me! What are YOU doing here!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_13: {SAY:zombossicon}And why are you conspiring with these troglodytes!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_14: {EXCITED:crazydave}Because they have their own tribe now!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_15: {SAY:zombossicon}Their resistance is futile. You should get out of here and let me do proper clean up!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_18: {SAY:winnie}Zomboss... have you been training these zombies to emulate the Elder Hailstorm?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_20: {SAY:zombossicon}Well, I MAY have given orders to appoint some of my own zombies as new sub-leaders working for me.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_21: {SAY:winnie}And you're copying the original, down to the clothes.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_22: {SAY:zombossicon}If it's war you're asking for, you have it.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_23: {SAY:crazydave}Aren't we already at war for years?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}I come back to the ice age to find my zombies under new leadership!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_4: {SAY:zombossicon}And half of them refuse to respect me anymore because of some wannabe!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}Inspired by the presence of "a weird man and his red metal mammoth"!????
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_6: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Boss Man, these zombies have moved on! I mean, you abandoned them!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, we've received yet another stone letter from Elder Hailstorm.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}Zomboss must be prepared. He is determined to reclaim his title as the tribe leader.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_13: {EXCITED:crazydave}He's got a whole truckload of zombies on his side already!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}Zomboss is a prideful zombie, and he's not going to let defiance like this go.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, I retract my previous doubt.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_16: {SAY:winnie}This alliance could prove very useful for us.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_17: {SAY:winnie}If we succeed in defeating Zomboss, we may break the ice with these zombies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_19: {SAY:winnie}We're truly experiencing a revolutionary moment in history.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_20: {EXCITED:crazydave}I never thought I'd see the day.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}"We fight back at big brain zombie."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}"We beat big brain zombie! We free tribe!"
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}HAH! Did you really expect Elder Hailstorm to be able to defeat me!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_INTRO_10: {SAY:zombossicon}I shall retake my rightful place as the ruler of zombies in this era.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_INTRO_4: {SAY:zombossicon}He couldn't even keep himself from getting frozen!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_INTRO_5: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Boss Man, this has to stop! You have to leave this tribe alone!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_INTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}Since when do you care about zombies!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_INTRO_8: {EXCITED:crazydave}These zombies don't even wanna eat our brains anymore!

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_OUTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}Why have you helped them seperate from me!?

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_OUTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}At the very least I took out Elder Hailstorm with my explosion.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_OUTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Status Report: Despite being turned to ash, Elder Hailstorm is alive and well.

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_OUTRO_9: {SAY:zombossicon}Fine! They can have their little tribe all to themselves!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:greedy}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:greedy}I feel like you all aren't gettin' the point!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_10: {SAY:greedy}Right. Tell ya' what. I ain't an unreasonable man. Let's make a deal.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_11: {SAY:greedy}I give ya back... Let's say... 10% of your power. And you will be spared of the oncoming attack to boot.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_12: {SAY:greedy}In return, you tell me all the secrets of this place I've yet to uncover.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_14: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}I'd NEVER make deals with the likes of you!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_15: {SAY:greedy}Fine. I tried bein' civilized with you. Time fo' my boys to really show ya' what they can do with all these resources.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_17: {EXCITED:crazydave}It's another one of his huge attacks. Nothing the two of us can't handle!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_2: {SAY:greedy}Do I really gotta spell it out?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_3: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}Don't waste my time, get on with it!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_5: {SAY:greedy}Y'see, ever since my operations have been disapproved of by the big man himself, life's been tough for ol' Greedy.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_7: {SAY:greedy}And you brought three of 'em to me right when I've got all this!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_8: {SAY:greedy}How do you see that goin' down?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_9: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I have picked heroes intended to defeat you, this one even having done so previously.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_11_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:greedy}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:greedy}Why, you lot are as annoyin' as the tax-man.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_11_INTRO_2: {SAY:greedy}I suppose it can't be helped. I'll have to send in more of my boys after ya'.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_11_INTRO_4: {SAY:greedy}I don't know what he does, but have fun!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_11_INTRO_6: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}He may be talking about those zombies resembling Shikaisens.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_11_INTRO_7: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}These zombies use their vase to resurrect themselves.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_11_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}Looks like we'll have to do some vase breaking, neighbor!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_12_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}Once again, another plant seeks to join you!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_12_INTRO_2: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Iris can summon birds to attack and block zombies coming down their lane.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_13_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:greedy}{SAY:greedy}Now, tell me honestly. Have you ever wanted to... ascend to higher ranks?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_13_INTRO_10: {SAY:greedy}Maybe what you need is to meet an emperor. Someone who ascends others to higher ranks as you've described.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_13_INTRO_11: {NPC_EXIT:greedy}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}I am growing really tired of this robber.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_13_INTRO_12: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I am growing weaker as this incident continues.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_13_INTRO_13: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}If I fade away, what will become of humanity...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_13_INTRO_5: {SAY:greedy}Bein' above just an errand boy. Squabblin' with that leader of ours all tha time!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_13_INTRO_6: {SAY:greedy}What a waste o' a life. You could be makin' it big like me in the higher ranks o' society.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_13_INTRO_8: {SAY:greedy}That's... not exactly what I had in mind.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_13_INTRO_9: {SAY:greedy}But, y'know what I'll work with it.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:greedy}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:greedy}Ooooh, guess what ol' Greedy just found out.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_10: {SAY:greedy}No need to pretend. I heard it all. You took advantage of this lass so that you could get yourself a sandwich out o' the whole ordeal.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_11: {SAY:crazydave}What? It's just a sandwich. Makes all the troubles worth it.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_12: {SAY:greedy}Ah, that's what I like about ya'. Ya' know how to play your cards.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_13: {SAY:greedy}You saw an opportunity to take what you wanted and you grabbed it!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_14: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Hey! I agreed to give it to him as a reward! Really, it's the least I could do.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_15: {SAY:greedy}Hehehe... Always a pleasure to see someone bein' played.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_16: {SAY:greedy}You've got potential, David. You've got potential...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_17: {NPC_EXIT:greedy}{SAY:crazydave}I don't know what that was about, honest.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_5: {SAY:greedy}Your faith ain't in this little adventure, is it David?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_7: {SAY:greedy}You ain't doin' this out o' the kindness o' your heart, are you?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_10: {SAY:greedy}There's no shame in bein' a little greedy. That's how you get far in life... and unlife.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_11: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}...That's the problem with the outside world these days.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_12: {SAY:greedy}Like you said, why should this be your responsibility?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_13: {SAY:greedy}I didn't do nuthin' to you this time.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_14: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}We know what will happen if you succeed...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_15: {SAY:greedy}Is that what's holdin' all of 'em here? Vague threats? Your persuasion oughta do some work.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_16: {SAY:greedy}Imma go enjoy some luxury right now. I own it, after all.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_17: {NPC_EXIT:greedy}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}Dave... My power is growing even weaker.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_18: {SAY:crazydave}Look, I think it's just the weather or something.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_19: {TIRED:crazydave}I'll... take a bit of a look around.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}I don't know what that talk yesterday was about, but don't even try to pull anything!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_3: {SAY:greedy}Me!? Poor little ol' me? Pullin' somethin'? Fuggetaboutit.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_4: {SAY:greedy}I was just pointin' out that Dave's got a bit of a businessman in 'im. Tha's all.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}Look, fatso! I was pulled in here out of nowhere! I don't know where I am!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_6: {SAY:crazydave}I don't wanna be stuck here... and I wanted something to eat!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_7: {SAY:greedy}Uh-huh. There's no need to play coy with me.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_8: {SAY:greedy}Look at 'er. She's desperate. Willin' to give anythin' up for your help. Same goes for the other Davids.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_9: {SAY:greedy}Difference is: You saw how to monetize that. And that's alright.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_16_INTRO_10: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Looks like he plans to use it to claim some sun for himself
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_16_INTRO_11: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}...which will limit how much you can use.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_16_INTRO_12: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Be careful with your sun, Dave's Neighbor.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_16_INTRO_2: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I can't find him. Luckily, I have some stored up sun. There's quite a lot, actually.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_16_INTRO_6: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}Oh, once I get my hands on you...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_16_INTRO_7: {SAY:greedy}What? I thought you like responsible ownership.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_16_INTRO_8: {SAY:greedy}Here, lemme enforce it. Usin' a card! You won't be able to spend a dime!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_16_INTRO_9: {NPC_EXIT:greedy}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}He is using Offerings to a Sacred Mountain.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_10: {SAY:greedy}Right... right. Come on, don't start cryin' on me now. Girls these days...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_11: {SAY:greedy}Y'know David, without yo' car around, there's nobody who can tell you what to do.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_12: {SAY:greedy}You're free to do anythin' you want ova' here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_13: {SAY:greedy}Listenin' to this lass? Please! She ain't even from around where we are!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_14: {SAY:greedy}You don't have to defend this market, it ain't yours anyways.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_15: {SAY:greedy}In fact, I can make it be yours. You can get a lot more than just a sandwich outta this...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_16: {SAY:greedy}I can make lotsa things be yours.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_17: {SAY:crazydave}But... no! You already tried to make a deal with me once!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_18: {SAY:greedy}Yeah, and that stupid car got in the way! You don't have to listen to 'er here!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_19: {SAY:greedy}Seein' your little stunt earlier... You're your own man once you're off the chain. I've looked up your history...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}Chimata, I decided to go ahead and get this lawn set up early!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_20: {SAY:greedy}Makin' deals. Sellin' things out of your car. Heh. A marketplace is the ideal location for you, ain't it?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_21: {SAY:crazydave}If I make any deal with you, you're just going to come back and steal everything!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_22: {SAY:greedy}Oh no. I've got more than what I need ova' here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_24: {SAY:greedy}I guarantee you, I'll make you an offer you can't refuse.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_26: {SAY:greedy}Tell me, you traveled all those worlds to get yourself a taco... One you never even ended up eatin'.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_27: {SAY:greedy}Just some sub-par replacement Zomboss cooked up to keep ya' occupied.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_29: {SAY:greedy}...I can get you that taco you've so been desiring.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_3: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}That's splendid! But why weren't you doing this before?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_33: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}Dave, don't be persuaded by his blackhearted offerings!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_34: {SAY:greedy}It's a fair deal at the market place.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_35: {SAY:greedy}As for you... I'm using a card to harness the ability of an underground sun!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_7: {SAY:greedy}He doesn't wanna be helpin' ya, toots! You kidnapped 'im!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_8: {SAY:greedy}Don't you get the idea by now!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_9: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I... needed help... for the sake of humanity.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_10: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}You just don't know when to stop, do you? You're despicable.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_11: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}And you're a manchild on top of that.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_12: {SAY:greedy}Now, I thought you were above name calling, oh-goddess of ownership!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_14: {SAY:greedy}And guess what! David is actually considering my offer! Haha!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_16: {NPC_EXIT:greedy}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}There's still faith. I can sense it.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_2: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}The faith in me is deteriorating... Dave is nowhere to be found...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_3: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Was he really so greedy to the point he pursued a taco for worlds on end...?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_4: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Well, I guess everyone has their desires... It couldn't have been that bad, right?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_5: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I am hoping that by using the power of these colorful plants...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_6: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I can remind everyone of who I am and gain some of my faith back.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_7: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Including Dave's own faith in himself. I know how that feels...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_12: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Ha... I knew he couldn't be that bad.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_14: {SAY:crazydave}You mean the cards I stole from you?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_16: {SAY:crazydave}I'm not like you! That taco might've been an unfulfilled desire, but I've moved on!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_17: {SAY:crazydave}I travel with Penny now! I don't need some kind of "reward" anymore!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_18: {EXCITED:crazydave}That journey is what it's really about!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_19: {TIRED:crazydave}I lost sight of that. I'm sorry, Chimata.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_20: {SAY:crazydave}I shouldn't have asked you for anything. That's not why I fight zombies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_21: {EXCITED:crazydave}You need protection from zombies, and Crazy Dave's the man to call!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_25: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I knew you could do it, Dave. I could tell you still held faith.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_26: {SAY:greedy}Hahaha! Fine, then! I'll just level you with the pavement!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_27: {SAY:greedy}You might have taken my core stash, but I've still got backups!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_28: {SAY:greedy}And there's one card you didn't know I had on me! My ace in the hole!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_30: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}That card? I didn't even know it was still around!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_32: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}It was made with the help of Kappa, it was related to a different incident.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_33: {SAY:greedy}If I can't have any riches, nobody can!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_35: {NPC_EXIT:greedy}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}The good news is, the display of plants from last night has garnered me some faith back.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_36: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}If we can live through tonight and tomorrow, I should be able to do something about all this!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_37: {SAY:crazydave}Our plant costs seem to be all wonky, but I am sure we can handle it!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_5: {SAY:greedy}Oh, he reached me personally! He REALLY wanted that taco.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_6: {TIRED:crazydave}I'm sorry... I've been chasing it for so long.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}And with Greed Guy's card powers, he can make it real again.

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_1_INTRO_4: {SAY:crazydave}I just remember some kind of flash...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_1_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}Looks like we don't have time to ask questions, there's zombies here too!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_1_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}Good thing there's some extra sun laying around!
